column4: Institute of Drafting Technologists
Sri Lanka (Incorporation)
to charge fees, subscriptions and contributions in
respect  of  admission  of  persons  to  any  grade  of
membership  of  the  Body  Corporate  and  for  the
renewal of such membership;
to charge fees, subscriptions and contributions for
the  courses  conducted  by  the  Body  Corporate
which are accredited by TVEC;
to  appoint  any  sub-  committees,  consultative
committees  or  any  other  committee  as  and  when
necessary to carry out any functions of the Body
Corporate as may be determined by the Executive
Committee;
to take disciplinary action against members of the
Body Corporate for violation of any rules prescribed
under section 6 pertaining to the general conduct,
discipline  and  the  vocational  activities  of  the
members of the Body Corporate;
to collaborate with, assist, receive assistance from,
and develop links with, other persons, agencies and
organizations in Sri Lanka or abroad, having objects
similar to those of the Body Corporate;
to publish journals, monographs, books and other
material  for  disseminating  information  and
knowledge relating to or connected with the science
of Drafting Technology;
to utilise the moneys of the Body Corporate to meet
all expenditure incurred in carrying out its objects,
in remunerating its employees and in the exercise
of its powers and duties;
generally to do all such acts and things authorized
by  this  Act  and  Rules  made  thereunder  for  the
achievement of the objects of the Body Corporate.
